subject: lg-dy
title: LG.DY.------EXT.F.
description: Chart on book p. 97 (CS-25). LG-DY (logical dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; EXT-F (extended functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: PROG-TF-C (progressional transfer cycles) and LANG-DY (language dynamics). From PROG-TF-C: INDIV-DY-TD (individual tendencies). From LANG-DY: MT-IMP (multi-implications). From MT-IMP: MTH (methodology) and PHY-U-C (physical universe context). From MTH: POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PHY-U-C: POL-P (political policies).
